meta.promptText: Which brand's formal shirts should I buy for men in India?

response.text:
If you're buying **formal shirts for men in India**, I’d shortlist these brands:

| Brand | Best for | Typical sweet spot |
|---|---|---:|
| **Van Heusen** | Best overall / daily office wear | ₹1,000–₹2,500 |
| **Louis Philippe** | Premium, polished corporate look | ₹1,500–₹3,500 |
| **Arrow** | Classic, sophisticated formal wear | ₹1,200–₹3,000 |
| **Raymond** | Traditional, high-quality formal styling | ₹1,000–₹3,000 |
| **Peter England** | Best budget/value | ₹700–₹1,800 |
| **Park Avenue** | Affordable everyday office shirts | ₹700–₹1,800 |
| **Allen Solly** | Modern/slightly less conservative office wear | ₹1,000–₹2,500 |


Recent 2026 comparisons consistently put Van Heusen, Louis Philippe, Arrow, Raymond and Peter England among the stronger formal-shirt choices in India. [www.flickonclick.com](https://www.flickonclick.com/best-formal-shirt-brands/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[midvey.com](https://midvey.com/blogs/news/top-10-best-formal-shirt-brands-in-india-for-2026?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### My picks

**🥇 Best overall: Van Heusen**  
If you want one brand without overthinking it, I'd choose Van Heusen. Good balance of fit, formal appearance, comfort and price. Current listings also show solid formal shirts around ₹840–₹1,000, although prices vary with discounts. [Van Heusen Men Solid Formal]()

**🥈 Best premium: Louis Philippe**  
Choose this if you're dressing for senior-management meetings, client meetings, interviews or want a more refined wardrobe. [Louis Philippe Men Cotton Fit Formal Shirt]()

**🥉 Best classic: Arrow**  
A good choice if you prefer traditional, understated corporate styling. [Arrow Men's Formal Shirt]()

**💰 Best value: Peter England**  
Particularly good if you need 5–7 shirts for regular office rotation rather than a few premium shirts.

### What I'd actually buy

For a versatile professional wardrobe, I'd get:

- **2 white** — plain, full sleeve
- **2 light blue** — plain
- **1 pale pink/lavender**
- **1 subtle blue/white stripe**
- **1 premium shirt** from Louis Philippe or Arrow

Prioritize **100% cotton or good cotton-rich fabric**, a clean spread/semi-spread collar, and the correct fit. A ₹1,200 shirt that fits perfectly will generally look better than a ₹3,000 shirt that doesn't. [www.flickonclick.com](https://www.flickonclick.com/best-formal-shirt-brands/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[midvey.com](https://midvey.com/blogs/news/top-10-best-formal-shirt-brands-in-india-for-2026?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

If you tell me your **budget per shirt (e.g. ₹1,000, ₹1,500, ₹2,500)** and whether you want **slim fit, regular fit, or a broader/athletic fit**, I can narrow it down to the **best 5–10 shirts you can buy right now in India**.
